content:
Alex Chen: Quick postmortem follow-up — consolidating DR / regional failover action items from yesterday's postmortem. TL;DR: assign owners, short timelines, surface recurring patterns, and schedule a game day. I'll add proposals below. Please react with :white_check_mark: if you accept or reply with conflicts.

Priya Nair: Adding communications & customer impact checklist to the sheet: https://internal.redwood/sheets/dr-followups (see tab 'comm-plan'). Will own outbound comms. :+1:

Mateo Ruiz: I'll take multi-region routing tests (canary + latency steering + failback). Proposed target: 2 weeks, deliverables: test plan + automation job + perf baseline. Owner: Mateo Ruiz — :white_check_mark:.

Kira Owens: I'll update the restore runbook to include explicit PITR/db-consistency steps and post-restore validation. Plan to push a draft to `docs/runbooks/restore.md`. ETA: 4 business days.

Lina Park: I can coordinate the game day. Suggest date: Tue 2026-04-08 09:00 PT. Agenda: dry-run restore, failover routing, cache-drain, rollback window. sRE-oncall can you confirm availability?

sRE-oncall: Confirmed for 2026-04-08. I'll reserve the war-room channel and page oncall for the drill. Need final runbook by end of next week.

Daniel Ho: Noting a recurring pattern: routing flaps + stale cache after failover (seen in 3 incidents last 9 months). Action: implement a KV cache drain hook + graceful connection drain on routing change. Owner: Daniel Ho, ETA 5 days. Will add a small test harness to simulate drain.

Samir Patel: I'll implement router policy `graceful-failover-v1` and add telemetry hooks for rollbacks. PR assigned: gitlab.com/redwood/infra/merge_requests/1234. Targeting code review in 3 days.

Alex Chen: Action items (consolidated):
- Mateo: multi-region routing tests + automation — due 2 weeks — :white_check_mark:
- Kira: restore runbook update + validation steps — due 4 business days
- Daniel: KV cache drain hook + tests — due 5 days
- Samir: router policy + telemetry PR — due 3 days
- Priya: comms plan & customer templates — due 3 business days
- Lina / sRE-oncall: game day logistics + war-room — confirm date by EOD
- Ops: create Jira epic and link all tasks (ops-bot did this)

ops-bot: Epic created: INFRA-7890 (DR remediation + game day). Attachments: link to epic: https://jira.redwood/browse/INFRA-7890

Priya Nair: Also adding a short customer-facing FAQ draft to the comms sheet. Will need legal review — @Alex Chen can you loop them in?

Alex Chen: Looping legal now. Also adding weekly follow-up cadence: 30-min triage every Monday for 6 weeks. First meeting: Mon 2026-03-30 10:00 PT. Calendar invites going out.

Mateo Ruiz: One note on tests: need an isolated routing env to run latency-steering experiments. @Samir Patel can you grant test cluster access?

Samir Patel: Yes, granting a transient test cluster (infra-test-3). I'll add IAM perms and doc the commands:

```
# request access
aws-vault exec infra-admin -- terraform apply -var 'env=infra-test-3'
```

Daniel Ho: For the cache-drain hook I'll add a pre-switch step in the routing playbook: drain KV, wait X sec, then flip traffic. Proposing X=30s as default; we can tune after game day.

Kira Owens: Will add validation checklist to runbook: verify write-forwarding, schema check, smoke queries, and sample-level SLO checks.

Lina Park: Tentatively scheduling 2-hour window for the game day and 1 hour buffer for rollback. Will send invites after sRE-oncall confirms time.

ops-bot: Friendly reminder: tag all PRs and docs with `INFRA-7890` so they're auto-linked to the epic.

sRE-oncall: Quick ops note — during the last failover the DB replica promotion had a 7s lag spike. We should capture replication lag metrics in the alerting runbook. Action assigned to Kira for runbook note.

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll mark owners as accepted if I get :white_check_mark: or a direct reply. If no reply by EOD today, we'll escalate to oncall for temporary ownership. Keeping this thread as canonical tracker; please update the Jira epic as work progresses.

Kira Owens: :white_check_mark:
Mateo Ruiz: :white_check_mark:
Daniel Ho: :white_check_mark:
Samir Patel: :white_check_mark:
Priya Nair: :white_check_mark:
Lina Park: I'll confirm after syncing with calendar — maybe later today.

Alex Chen: All right — closing initial triage. Expect invites and the updated sheet in ~1 hour. If anything changes ping me directly. :rocket:
